title: Gold Miners Beat Every S&P 500 Sector in Q3 Despite September Selloff
summary: If you only looked at the price of gold in September, you’d be forgiven for believing the bull market had run out of steam. The yellow metal fell 6.3% during the month, and some in the financial press were quick to say it had failed as a safe haven.
